beats.en: Welcome to Lesson 6. When the four answer choices are different forms of the same verb, the SAT is testing one of two things.
beats.ko: 6강에 오신 걸 환영해요. 선택지 네 개가 같은 동사의 다른 형태라면, SAT는 둘 중 하나를 묻고 있어요.
beats.zh: 欢迎来到第6课。如果四个选项是同一个动词的不同形式，SAT考的是两件事之一。

beats.en: First: does the sentence have a main verb? Second: which tense fits the time of the passage?
beats.ko: 첫째, 문장에 본동사가 있는가? 둘째, 지문의 시간에 맞는 시제는 무엇인가?
beats.zh: 第一：句子有没有谓语动词？第二：哪个时态符合文章的时间？

beats.en: Check them in that order. It solves most verb questions quickly.
beats.ko: 이 순서대로 확인하세요. 동사 문제 대부분이 빠르게 풀려요.
beats.zh: 按这个顺序检查，大多数动词题都能很快解决。

beats.en: Remember from Lesson 1: a complete sentence needs a verb with a tense.
beats.ko: 1강을 기억하세요. 완전한 문장에는 시제 있는 동사가 필요해요.
beats.zh: 回忆第1课：完整句子需要有时态的动词。

beats.en: Forms ending in i-n-g, forms with 'to,' and 'having' forms cannot be the main verb by themselves.
beats.ko: ing로 끝나는 형태, to가 붙은 형태, having 형태는 혼자서 본동사가 될 수 없어요.
beats.zh: 以 ing 结尾的形式、带 to 的形式和 having 形式都不能单独作谓语动词。

beats.en: 'The engineers testing the new design.' There is no tensed verb. It is a fragment.
beats.ko: 'The engineers testing the new design.' 시제 있는 동사가 없어요. 문장 조각이에요.
beats.zh: The engineers testing the new design. 没有有时态的动词，这是句子片段。

beats.en: 'The engineers tested the new design.' Now it has a main verb.
beats.ko: 'The engineers tested the new design.' 이제 본동사가 있어요.
beats.zh: The engineers tested the new design. 现在有谓语动词了。

beats.en: The SAT hides this in long sentences. 'The archaeologists, who had spent a decade searching the valley, blank, the ruins of a temple in 2016.'
beats.ko: SAT는 이걸 긴 문장 속에 숨겨요. 'The archaeologists, who had spent a decade searching the valley' 다음 빈칸, 그리고 'the ruins of a temple in 2016.'
beats.zh: SAT会把它藏在长句里：The archaeologists, who had spent a decade searching the valley，空格，the ruins of a temple in 2016.

beats.en: 'Had spent' is a verb, but it belongs to the who clause. It is extra information. The main sentence still needs its own verb.
beats.ko: 'had spent'도 동사지만 who절에 속해요. 추가 정보예요. 주된 문장에는 여전히 자기 동사가 필요해요.
beats.zh: had spent 也是动词，但它属于 who 从句，是补充信息。主句仍然需要自己的动词。

beats.en: Only 'discovered' has a tense. A, B, and D would leave the sentence without a main verb. The answer is C.
beats.ko: 시제가 있는 건 'discovered'뿐이에요. A, B, D를 고르면 문장에 본동사가 없어요. 정답은 C예요.
beats.zh: 只有 discovered 有时态。选 A、B、D，句子就没有谓语动词。答案是 C。

beats.en: “The new library, designed to hold over a million books, ___ to the public next spring.”
beats.ko: “The new library, designed to hold over a million books, ___ to the public next spring.”
beats.zh: “The new library, designed to hold over a million books, ___ to the public next spring.”

beats.en: If all the choices are tensed verbs, look for a time clue: a date, a word like 'currently' or 'last year,' or the tense of nearby verbs.
beats.ko: 선택지가 모두 시제 있는 동사라면 시간 단서를 찾으세요. 날짜, currently나 last year 같은 말, 또는 주변 동사의 시제요.
beats.zh: 如果选项都是有时态的动词，就找时间线索：日期、currently 或 last year 这类词，或者附近动词的时态。

beats.en: 'In 1890, the city built a canal. The canal carried goods to the coast and, blank, the local economy.'
beats.ko: 'In 1890, the city built a canal. The canal carried goods to the coast and' 다음 빈칸, 'the local economy.'
beats.zh: In 1890, the city built a canal. The canal carried goods to the coast and，空格，the local economy.

beats.en: The date is in the past, and the nearby verbs 'built' and 'carried' are past tense. So the answer is 'grew.'
beats.ko: 날짜가 과거이고 주변 동사 built와 carried도 과거 시제예요. 그래서 정답은 grew예요.
beats.zh: 日期是过去，附近的动词 built 和 carried 也是过去时。所以答案是 grew。

beats.en: Do not pick a tense because it sounds fancy. Match the time of the passage.
beats.ko: 멋있어 보이는 시제를 고르지 마세요. 지문의 시간에 맞추세요.
beats.zh: 不要因为听起来高级就选某个时态。要与文章的时间一致。

beats.en: Now perfect tenses. 'Has' or 'have' plus a past participle connects the past to now. 'Since' and 'for' are strong clues.
beats.ko: 이제 완료 시제예요. has나 have에 과거분사를 붙이면 과거부터 지금까지를 이어요. since와 for가 강한 단서예요.
beats.zh: 现在看完成时。has 或 have 加过去分词，把过去和现在连起来。since 和 for 是强线索。

beats.en: 'Had' plus a past participle shows an action that happened before another past action. 'The train had left by the time we arrived.'
beats.ko: had에 과거분사를 붙이면 다른 과거 일보다 먼저 일어난 일을 나타내요. 'The train had left by the time we arrived.'
beats.zh: had 加过去分词表示在另一个过去动作之前发生的事。The train had left by the time we arrived.

beats.en: And 'will have' plus a past participle means something will be finished before a point in the future.
beats.ko: will have에 과거분사를 붙이면 미래의 어느 시점 전에 끝나 있을 일을 뜻해요.
beats.zh: will have 加过去分词表示在将来某个时间点之前会完成的事。

beats.en: After have, has, or had, you need the past participle, not the simple past.
beats.ko: have, has, had 뒤에는 단순 과거형이 아니라 과거분사를 써야 해요.
beats.zh: 在 have、has 或 had 后面，要用过去分词，而不是一般过去式。

beats.en: For many irregular verbs, they look different: write, wrote, written. Begin, began, begun. Rise, rose, risen.
beats.ko: 불규칙 동사는 모양이 달라요. write, wrote, written. begin, began, begun. rise, rose, risen.
beats.zh: 很多不规则动词形式不同：write, wrote, written；begin, began, begun；rise, rose, risen。

beats.en: So 'She has wrote three novels' is wrong. It should be 'She has written three novels.'
beats.ko: 그래서 'She has wrote three novels'는 틀려요. 'She has written three novels'가 맞아요.
beats.zh: 所以 She has wrote three novels 是错的，应该是 She has written three novels。

beats.en: Let's solve one. First, the main verb check. C, 'becoming,' has no tense. Eliminate it.
beats.ko: 한 문제 풀어 봐요. 먼저 본동사 확인. C 'becoming'은 시제가 없어요. 지워요.
beats.zh: 做一道题。先检查谓语动词。C becoming 没有时态，排除。

beats.en: Now the time clue: 'Since 1991.' 'Since' connects the past to now. That calls for the present perfect.
beats.ko: 이제 시간 단서. 'Since 1991.' since는 과거부터 지금까지를 이어요. 현재완료가 필요해요.
beats.zh: 再看时间线索：Since 1991。since 把过去和现在连起来，需要现在完成时。

beats.en: 'Became' stays only in the past, and 'will become' is the future. The answer is B, 'has become.'
beats.ko: became은 과거에만 머물고, will become은 미래예요. 정답은 B 'has become'이에요.
beats.zh: became 只停留在过去，will become 是将来。答案是 B has become。

beats.en: “By the time the rescue team arrived, the storm ___ most of the village.”
beats.ko: “By the time the rescue team arrived, the storm ___ most of the village.”
beats.zh: “By the time the rescue team arrived, the storm ___ most of the village.”

beats.en: Let's review. First, make sure the sentence has a main verb. i-n-g forms, 'to' forms, and 'having' forms do not count.
beats.ko: 정리할게요. 먼저 문장에 본동사가 있는지 확인하세요. ing 형태, to 형태, having 형태는 본동사가 아니에요.
beats.zh: 我们来总结。首先确认句子有谓语动词。ing 形式、to 形式和 having 形式都不算。

beats.en: Second, find a time clue and match the tense.
beats.ko: 둘째, 시간 단서를 찾아 시제를 맞추세요.
beats.zh: 第二，找时间线索，让时态一致。

beats.en: 'Since' and 'for' point to the present perfect. An earlier past points to the past perfect.
beats.ko: since와 for는 현재완료, 더 이전의 과거는 과거완료를 가리켜요.
beats.zh: since 和 for 指向现在完成时；更早的过去指向过去完成时。

beats.en: And after have, has, or had, use the past participle. Next lesson: pronouns. See you in Lesson 7!
beats.ko: 그리고 have, has, had 뒤에는 과거분사를 써요. 다음은 대명사예요. 7강에서 만나요!
beats.zh: 在 have、has、had 后面用过去分词。下一课：代词。第7课见！
